title: George H.W. Bush says public not ready for UFO truth

tellings.quote: he starts going off about how you know the American public is not ready for the truth on UFOs which is definitely offs script from what he would usually say

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around 2015 or 2016, at a campaign event for Jeb Bush, the former US president George H.W. Bush started talking about how the American public was not ready for the truth about UFOs. Michels stresses that this was well off script for him. If meant seriously, it would suggest a former president knew there was a truth being held back.
